verdict.rationale: Docs reference a 'Quick Start' section, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API access, self-managed rate limits and capacity expansion 'with no additional cost' — all implying a self-serve model without sales calls — but no evidence in the pack actually walks through the sign-up flow or the steps to generate/mint an API key. missing for 10: explicit sign-up page/API key creation instructions, confirmation of no waitlist or approval gate, and independent developer confirmation that onboarding is frictionless.
